summary: pdrender is a terminal renderer for Bulldocs portable-doc block trees, producing width-aware ANSI-styled output via lipgloss — the terminal counterpart to the Phoenix HTML renderer. It maps every block type (heading, paragraph, code, table, figure, field-*, sheet, form, diagram, etc.) to terminal-safe output with graceful degradation for blocks that have no honest terminal representation.

intentions.title: Render Bulldocs content natively in the Go TUI without a browser
intentions.evidence: pdrender.go package comment calls it 'the terminal counterpart to render.ex'; DefaultRegistry wires all block types; RenderDoc produces a single ANSI string the TUI paper-viewer embeds directly

intentions.title: Mirror render.ex's block model exactly so document fidelity is consistent across surfaces
intentions.evidence: Every renderer cites its render.ex counterpart (compose_block, heading_style/2, compose_inline/2); field names, recursion shape, and inline node coercion all mirror the Elixir side

intentions.title: Honest graceful degradation for terminal-impossible blocks
intentions.evidence: hardblocks.go: diagram/asciicast/image each render a clearly-labeled placeholder box instead of faking a capability; comment explains why (sixel smear, no Mermaid lib, .cast is a stream)

intentions.title: Keep pdrender extractable as a standalone module (clean import seam)
intentions.evidence: pdrender.go IMPORT DISCIPLINE comment: only lipgloss + x/ansi + stdlib; Theme and Block are owned types injected by the caller; no apiclient or main-package dependency

intentions.title: Width-aware, ANSI-correct text layout without a constraint solver
intentions.evidence: RenderCtx.Width passed immutably down the tree; WithWidth/Deeper derive narrowed contexts; wrapLines uses ansi.Wrap for cell-accurate wrapping; MinWidth floor drops chrome at narrow widths

intentions.title: Support adaptive color profiles and OSC 8 hyperlinks per terminal capability
intentions.evidence: Profile enum (NoColor→TrueColor) in pdrender.go; supportsHyperlinks gates OSC 8 on ≥ANSI256; asciicastRenderer and inline link renderer both follow this gate

intentions.title: Expose resolver seams for field-reference and codelist lookups without coupling to the API client
intentions.evidence: RenderCtx.RefResolver and CodelistResolver are caller-supplied func fields; nil fallback renders raw id/code; mirrors render.ex's injected :ref_resolver / :codelist_resolver opts

intentions.title: Support the full schema-v2 and sheet block vocabulary for ONIX/Bulldocs content in the TUI
intentions.evidence: DefaultRegistry registers composite/arrayOf/codelist/localizedText (v2fields.go) and PdSheet/sheet (sheet.go); form/questionnaire alias registered for paperflow questionnaire blocks
